title: 第9章 太子，她是你皇婶婶(1)

content_zh:
“我叫薛蔷，你叫什么名字？今年多大了？家里有什么人啊？有没有婚配……”
薛蔷的话还没说完，忽然感觉到一股冷嗖嗖的寒意在他颈部蔓延，像一只手，遏制住了他的咽喉。
不好！有杀气！
“谁？”薛蔷快速拔出宝剑刺向身后的危险来源处，在看清楚来人，薛蔷的表情变得有些呆滞，手中的剑“哐当”一声掉在地上。
“十……十四爷？”
薛蔷的声音不大，只有旁边的几个人听到了。
看到凭空出现的夏侯擎天，所有人脸色大变，夏侯楠率先快步上前，恭恭敬敬地对紫衣男子行礼，“十四叔！”其他几人也规规矩矩地行礼，之后站得毕恭毕敬，整齐地道了声“十四爷！”
原本松散的空气，因为紫衣男子的出现一下子变得凝重起来，这些在京城飞扬跋扈的官二代们各个夹紧了尾巴，屏住呼吸，生怕惹恼了眼前的这一位。
“薛家小子，你对爷拔剑，是想跟爷决斗么？就你那三脚猫功夫，能在爷手里走几招呢？”
夏侯擎天的声音不急不缓，悠悠地地砸在薛蔷的心上，让他忍不住哆嗦起来，光洁的额头上瞬间布满了密密麻麻的一层薄汗。
和夏侯擎天？
他就算吃了雄心豹子胆，也不敢这么做！
可是大陆上的规矩，拔出武器就是要求决斗的意思，如果夏侯擎天硬抓着这条规矩不放，他该如何是好？
薛蔷觉得自己出门应该看看黄道吉日，怎么就撞上这个煞神了！真是流年不利！
比起其他人的战战兢兢，眼前的俊美男子让薛子怡看得有些痴了。
大周皇室盛产美男子，夏侯楠的容貌在皇子中是最出众的，可是他和夏侯擎天站一起简直是云泥之别，差距不是一般的大。更何况夏侯擎天身上独有的霸气是夏侯楠没有的，薛子怡不由得心跳加速，眼神迷乱。
见夏侯擎天为难薛蔷，薛子怡连忙来到夏侯擎天面前，柔柔地福了福，娇声开口。
“十四爷，我弟弟他不是故意的，您误会他了！他不过是小孩子，求您看在我的面子上，别跟他一般见识！”
薛子怡抬头看着夏侯擎天，努力摆出自认为最美的表情，可是在对上一双冷漠无情的眼睛后，她的心脏差点儿被冻住。
好骇人的眼神，好可怕——

“爷许你说话了？爷说话，有你开口的份儿么！”
夏侯擎天扫了眼薛子怡脸上的春色，露出一个极其厌恶的表情，好像她是什么脏东西似的，往后退了两步拉开距离，明摆着是嫌弃对方。
夏侯擎天的举动，让薛子怡倍受打击。
薛子怡对自己的美貌非常自信，这些年拜倒在她石榴裙下的名贵公子数不胜数，为什么这位王爷对她如避蛇蝎，难道传闻是真的？他真的是断袖？
不等薛子怡想明白，更打击人的话冲夏侯擎天嘴里爆发出来。
“你的面子？呵……你的面子能值几个铜子？也好意思在爷面前显摆！就连你爹在爷面前也不敢摆面子！”
“看来，爷长久不去京城，大家都忘了爷的性子。得空回去，爷找阴山公好好喝两杯，问问他是怎么教养的女儿，面子竟然跟爷一般大，真是教的好啊！还有，你最好在爷面前收起那副惺惺作态的丑模样！爷不是小四，别把爷当瞎子！”
被夏侯擎天当众指责没有家教，更被说丑，薛子怡脸色惨白。
她一直是京城贵女的典范，无论家世、容貌、才华还是武功都女子中的翘楚，堪称楷模，是人人羡慕的对象，哪里受过这样的羞辱！
更何况对方毫不留情地点破她内心里那些隐晦的念头，让薛子怡愈发无地自容，泪珠子如同断了线的珍珠链子一般，一颗颗往下缀着，身子更是摇摇欲坠，仿佛受到了极大的打击，一阵风就能将她吹倒。
“我……我没有……”薛子怡摇着头，珍珠耳坠微微颤抖，说不出的楚楚可怜。
若是寻常男人，早就怜香惜玉，把美人拥在怀里好好疼惜了。可惜，薛子怡打错了算盘，夏侯擎天非常人也！
“再恶心爷，爷就割了你的舌头，挖了你的眼睛！”夏侯擎天丢出一把匕首，吓得薛子怡直接晕了过去。
玉绯烟万万没想到，夏侯擎天居然是夏侯楠的皇叔。
她早该想到，他姓夏侯，又是这样跋扈的性子，偏偏通身贵气不是寻常人能比拟的，也只有大周国的皇室才能生产出这样奇葩的人物来。

content_en:
"My name is Xue Qiang, what's your name? How old are you this year? Who is there in the family? Are you married..."
Before Xue Qiang finished speaking, he suddenly felt a cold chill spreading on his neck, like a hand, restraining his throat.
not good! There is murderous intent!
"Who?" Xue Qiang quickly pulled out his sword and stabbed the source of danger behind him. After seeing clearly who was coming, Xue Qiang's expression became a little dull, and the sword in his hand fell to the ground with a clang.
"Ten...Fourteenth Master?"
Xue Qiang's voice was not loud, and only a few people nearby heard it.
Seeing Xia Hou Qingtian appearing out of thin air, everyone's expressions changed drastically. Xia Hounan took the lead and quickly stepped forward and saluted the man in purple respectfully, "Uncle Fourteenth!" Several other people also saluted politely, and then stood respectfully and said neatly, "Uncle Fourteenth!"
The originally loose air suddenly became tense due to the appearance of the man in purple. These second-generation officials who were domineering in the capital all clamped their tails and held their breath, for fear of offending the man in front of them.
"Xue family boy, you drew your sword at me, do you want to fight me in a duel? With your three-legged cat kung fu, how many moves can you do in my hands?"
Xiahou Qingtian's voice was neither urgent nor slow, hitting Xue Qiang's heart leisurely, making him tremble uncontrollably, and his smooth forehead was instantly covered with a thin layer of sweat.
With Xiahou Qingtian?
Even if he took the courage of his ambition, he would not dare to do this!
But according to the rules on the mainland, drawing out a weapon means asking for a duel. If Xiahou Qingtian insists on clinging to this rule, what should he do?
Xue Qiang felt that she should check the auspicious days when she went out, but why did she bump into this evil god! What a bad time!
Compared to the trepidation of others, Xue Ziyi was a little obsessed with the handsome man in front of her.
The royal family of the Great Zhou Dynasty is rich in handsome men, and Xia Hounan's appearance is the most outstanding among the princes, but he and Xiahou Qingtian are as different as clouds and mud when they stand together, and the gap is not ordinary. What's more, Xia Hou Qingtian's unique domineering spirit was something Xia Hou Nan didn't have. Xue Ziyi couldn't help but her heartbeat quickened and her eyes were confused.
Seeing that Xiahou Qingtian was in trouble for Xue Qiang, Xue Ziyi hurriedly came to Xiahou Qingtian, blessed her softly, and spoke softly.
"Fourteenth Master, my brother didn't do it on purpose. You misunderstood him! He is just a child. Please, for my sake, don't be as knowledgeable as him!"
Xue Ziyi looked up at Xia Hou Qingtian, trying to put on what she thought was the most beautiful expression, but when she met a pair of cold and heartless eyes, her heart almost froze.
What a terrifying look, so terrifying——
"Did I give you permission to speak? When I spoke, did you have the right to speak!"
Xia Hou Qingtian glanced at the spring color on Xue Ziyi's face, showing an expression of extreme disgust, as if she was some kind of dirty thing, and took two steps back to distance herself, clearly despising the other party.
Xue Ziyi was hit hard by Xiahou Qingtian's actions.
Xue Ziyi is very confident in her beauty. Over the years, there are countless noble princes who have fallen under her pomegranate skirt. Why does this prince treat her like a snake and a scorpion? Are the rumors true? Is he really cut off?
Before Xue Ziyi could think about it, even more shocking words burst into Xiahou Qingtian's mouth.
"Your face? Heh... How many coppers is your face worth? You have the nerve to show off in front of me! Even your father doesn't dare to show off in front of me!"
"It seems that I have been away from the capital for a long time and everyone has forgotten about my temperament. When I have time to go back, I will have a drink with Mr. Yinshan and ask him how he raised his daughter. She has as much face as I do. What a good teacher! Also, you'd better put away that ugly and pretentious look in front of me! I am not a mistress, so don't treat me as a blind man!"
Xue Ziyi turned pale when she was publicly accused by Xia Hou Qingtian of not having a tutor and even being called ugly.
She has always been a model of aristocratic women in the capital, regardless of familyShe is a leader among women in terms of life, appearance, talent and martial arts. She is a role model and the envy of everyone. How could she have ever been humiliated like this!
What's more, the other party mercilessly exposed the hidden thoughts in her heart, making Xue Ziyi even more embarrassed. Her tears were like broken pearl chains, one by one, hanging down. Her body was even more shaky, as if she had been hit hard, and a gust of wind could blow her down.
"I...I didn't..." Xue Ziyi shook her head, her pearl earrings trembling slightly, looking indescribably pitiful.
If he were an ordinary man, he would have cherished the beauty long ago and held the beauty in his arms and cherished her. It's a pity that Xue Ziyi made the wrong calculation, Xia Hou Qingtian is very human!
"If you are disgusting again, I will cut your tongue and gouge out your eyes!" Xia Hou Qingtian threw a dagger, which scared Xue Ziyi and fainted.
Yu Feiyan never expected that Xia Hou Qingtian was Xia Hou Nan's imperial uncle.
She should have thought that his surname was Xia Hou, and he had such a domineering temperament, but his aura of nobility was beyond the reach of ordinary people. Only the royal family of the Great Zhou Kingdom could produce such a strange person.
